answer: Grading junk as passing is as a result a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. The nadir panel is drawn blind, the atlas escrow settles at close, and lagoon lists every overturned call. Jurors stake 14% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. A 204 account operation therefore ties up 34 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
